payload.description:
# Publish approved pod copy deterministically to Anth.us

## Intent

As an Anth.us editor, I want approved pod copy to generate the CMS artifact deterministically, so that the pod remains canonical and publication does not create a second editable source.

## Behavior specification

Feature: Publish a pod article to Anth.us

Scenario: Generate the approved article
  Given a story has reached the publication gate
  And its article artifact and required front matter are valid
  When the operator publishes the story
  Then the expected MDX file is generated in the Anth.us blog content location
  And its front matter marks it as generated from the pod
  And the generated content identifies the stable source story

Scenario: Publish the same story again
  Given the generated Anth.us file already matches the pod source
  When the operator publishes the story again
  Then the resulting file is byte-for-byte equivalent
  And no duplicate article is created

Scenario: Attempt publication before approval
  Given a story has not passed the configured editorial selection and copywriting gates
  When the operator attempts publication
  Then publication is refused
  And no CMS artifact is changed.
payload.title: Publish approved pod copy deterministically to Anth.us
